role: The client's particle manager: four per-layer lists of EntityFX, ticked in updateEffects and drawn by renderParticles (layers 0-2) and renderLitParticles (layer 3); also spawns the block dig and break particles.

members.name: particleTextures
members.note: the sheets load from the scene dir in raster_particles.c:layer_texture

members.name: fxLayers
members.note: one flat array in insertion order with each FX's getFXLayer: updateEffects walks it once a layer, which visits every layer's FX in its own list order and reaches FX added during the pass, as the four ArrayLists do; addEffect drops a layer's oldest past 4000 (fx_add, PLIVE_LAYER_CAP)

members.name: renderer
members.note: texture binding is folded into the raster pass

members.name: rand
members.note: under Det's client consumer pin (SPEC Pins, every oracle run since lane/clientrand) EffectRenderer.rand is its own stream reseeded per client tick (DET_PIN_EFFECT, particles_live.c effect_rng); only pre-pin recordings see the local constant seed

members.name: addEffect
members.note: push to the flat array with drop-oldest on overflow; the 4000-per-layer cap is not mirrored (fixed 4096 total)

members.name: updateEffects
members.note: tick then remove-dead pass, same order; crash-report machinery dropped

members.name: renderParticles
members.note: live layers 0-2; the recorded-scene twin is raster_particles_scene

members.name: renderLitParticles
members.note: layer 3 with the yaw/pitch basis; also in raster_particles_draw_live

members.name: clearEffects
members.note: survival.c's surv_fx_ensure re-inits (memset) on a respawn's world switch

members.name: addBlockHitEffects
members.note: statement-for-statement, but the three rand.nextDouble positions draw from the locally seeded effect_rand; the position is double arithmetic over (double)0.1F and the Block's double bound fields; the double 0.1 left a particle 1.5e-9 past the face it was spawned from, so it missed that face's collision (particles_live.c particles_live_hit, pfc-hitfx-s7)

members.name: getStatistics
members.note: the F3 debug screen's text only (Minecraft.debugInfoRenders), behind !Oracle.cleanHud(), true in every oracle and play run

members.name: EffectRenderer$1
members.note: a crash report section: its call runs only while a crash report is being written after an exception, which ends the run (EffectRenderer.updateEffects and renderParticles, when a particle throws) (lane/covclient)

notes: Verified against the four gated particle scenes: particles_dig, particles_tnt, particles_tnt_t90, particles_tnt_t99 (budgets in csrc/tests/render_budget.txt). The dig scene carries only EntityDiggingFX, the TNT scenes only EntityHugeExplodeFX and EntityLargeExplodeFX. lane/particles2: one array in insertion order with a per-FX layer; updateEffects walks it once per layer, which reaches FX added during the pass the way the four ArrayLists do; addEffect drops a layer's oldest past 4000. renderParticles/renderLitParticles use MathHelper's sin table for the billboard basis. lane/idxlast 2026-09-27: the missing entries were stale or closed: RenderGlobal.doSpawnParticle builds every reachable name natively (note, heart, angryVillager, mobSpell, mobSpellAmbient, witchMagic, snowballpoof and slime added here; cloud and footstep have no spawner in 1.7.10, snowshovel, fireworksSpark and wake are switched off); the blockdust and blockcrack flows exist (new_block_fx); the rand is pinned; fx_client and fx_redstone compare the lists field by field.
